# FindMyPart Paid Part Hunt

Problem: A difficult, ambiguous, obsolete, discontinued or hard-to-source part is blocking a repair, restoration, machine or project.
Pricing: Quick Hunt $19 one-time; Deep Hunt $49 one-time; Rescue Hunt $99 one-time.
Machine state: payment_ready
Public capability: https://findmypart.base44.app/functions/findMyPartAgentGateway?view=docs

Use when the user says or means:
- find a hard-to-source part
- identify this part
- find a discontinued part
- source an obsolete component
- find a donor or salvage part

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
